source.title: Recommended Settings for Inverters (as per the GM meeting held on 2025-02-25)
source.note: Transcribed by software from the PDF. Check every number against the PDF before it is used on a real inverter. The PDF prints the under-frequency row as '47<f'; it is read here as f < 47 Hz.

ten_min_ov_pu.meaning: 10-minute average voltage limit for sustained operation. Above it the inverter disconnects or stops generating within 3 s.

ten_min_ov_s.meaning: Time to disconnect after the 10-minute average limit is passed

uv1_pu.meaning: Under-voltage stage 1 trip level. A higher setting trips the inverter during a grid dip.

uv1_s.meaning: Under-voltage stage 1 clearing time. A shorter setting trips the inverter too early.

of_hz.meaning: Over-frequency trip level. A lower setting trips the inverter too early.

uf_hz.meaning: Under-frequency trip level. A higher setting trips the inverter when the grid most needs it.

lvrt_enabled.meaning: Low-voltage ride-through must be active (Grid Connection Code July 2024, clause 3.17.3)

reconnect_v_min_pu.meaning: Lowest voltage at which the inverter may reconnect

reconnect_v_max_pu.meaning: Highest voltage at which the inverter may reconnect

reconnect_f_min_hz.meaning: Lowest frequency at which the inverter may reconnect

reconnect_f_max_hz.meaning: Highest frequency at which the inverter may reconnect

reconnect_ramp_s.meaning: Linear ramp back to full power (nameplate / 900 s)

lvrt_curve.ride_through: trip time varies linearly from 0.14 s to 1.2 s
